name: Moto Yan Kyonyuu Nurse no Ama Ero Kango
original_name: 元ヤン巨乳ナースの甘エロ看護
source: Hero Tomomi Amagi is coming home late from school due to being on the school's festival committee. He hears someone shout "STOP THIEF!!" before getting smacked by a guy on a motor scooter who was stealing a woman's purse. Tomomi breaks his leg in the process but the thief is stopped. At the hospital, he is told that he must be there for two weeks, which is about the time left before the festival. Head nurse Shizuru Kosaki is very mean and nasty to him, but the nurse in charge of him is a woman he once knew, who is very friendly to him. Can he heal up in time to attend?
translation: 英雄天城朋美因担任学校祭典委员会成员而放学回家很晚。他听到有人喊“阻止小偷！！”在被一个骑摩托车的人殴打之前，他正在偷一个女人的钱包。智美在此过程中摔断了腿，但小偷被阻止了。到了医院，他被告知必须住院两周，大约是节日之前的时间。护士长小崎静对他非常刻薄和恶劣，但负责他的护士是他曾经认识的一位女士，对他非常友好。他能及时康复并参加吗？
